loss_backend.name: fused-ssim
loss_backend.formula: L = 0.8*L1 + 0.2*(1 - SSIM); SSIM = fused_ssim(padding='same', train=True); L1 on the same BCHW contiguous tensors (P11 fused_total_loss semantics)

timing_note: wall/iter timing is NOT publication-grade unless timing_grade=PUBLICATION and the run was on a CLEAN_PUBLICATION_GPU

final_eval.reason: replay mode (--skip-eval): evaluation intentionally skipped; model/optimizer snapshots are the deliverable
